Hi Olivia —

Sorry for the hiccup, and thanks for the screenshot. This is a fairly common edge case: some enterprise calendars (or their mail gateways) rewrite or strip the ORGANIZER and X-ALT-DESC lines in incoming ICS files, which removes the embedded meeting URL for clients that expect it there.

Workarounds we can do immediately:
1) Create a Zoom meeting and send a new ICS generated by Zoom (organizer will be set properly). I've attached a Zoom-generated ICS: redwood-demo-zoom.ics.
2) Paste the Zoom join URL in the email body so attendees can click even if the calendar entry shows no link.
3) Add NovaPay's IT (it-support@novapay.com) to the invite attempt so their system can allowlist the organizer header for this event in future.

Temporary Zoom link (please use this now): https://zoom.us/j/1234567890?pwd=7FhQ
Passcode: 4821

I'll attach the Zoom ICS and can resend from Lauren or Karthik depending on which organizer you prefer. If your IT prefers to keep the organizer as our domain, let us know and we'll make Lauren the organizer.

Attachments: redwood-demo-zoom.ics

—
Ben Carter
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

Looping in CS — quick note from the ops side based on similar cases:
- If the calendar gateway removes ORGANIZER, some clients still render a URL if the URL appears in the event description (plain text). We should include both the ICS (from Zoom) and a plain-text fallback in the body.
- I'll also attach the invite headers we received on a similar incident (invite-headers.txt) so your IT can see which lines are important to preserve.

Proposed plan (fastest):
1) Resend an email with the Zoom join URL in the body + new Zoom ICS attached (ben already generated).
2) Send a second calendar update from Lauren@redwood.com (different organizer) if NovaPay's mail gateway continues to strip headers. Lauren's mailbox has been white-listed by a couple of customers — we can escalate to that if needed.
3) If your IT confirms they can allowlist, we'll revert organizer to Karthik for continuity.

I'll prepare the fallback Meet link (in case Zoom is blocked) as a second attachment and include both links in the email.

Attachments: invite-headers.txt
